why_post_hoc: Arm A (frozen live rule) results were already seen on this exact corpus; Arm B is chosen after seeing that only 18 of 36 Arm A trigger bars closed back at or above the level. This is NOT an independent test, there is no holdout, and no result here can grant authority.

arm_B_definition.approach: identical to Arm A: starts at the first bar with low < level; ends at the first bar with close >= level (the detector's re-arm bar)
arm_B_definition.entry: LONG at the CLOSE of the reclaim bar (the first bar of the approach with close >= level). If the trigger bar itself closes at or above the level, entry bar == trigger bar and the trade is identical to Arm A.
arm_B_definition.stop_anchor: approach extreme: minimum low over the bars from the trigger bar through the reclaim bar, minus 0.2 * atr_abs (the sweep_extreme analogue of crt_engine_v2.stop_price)
arm_B_definition.levels: core.gate_intelligence.compute_crt_levels(entry, 1, approach_extreme_low, reclaim_bar_high, atr_abs, 0.2, 1.0, 2.0), atr_abs = atr * close of the reclaim bar (F-072 / FM-074)
arm_B_definition.walk: research.oracle.multi_tp_walk defaults, max_forward = every bar left, same as Arm A
arm_B_definition.filters: NONE. No at_or_above_pdl, no timeframe or condition selection. Single timeframe H4, single entry rule.

cost: research.costs.xau_measured_cost_model() (SEM-015), exit_kind from the walk, nights_held=0 (swap UNMEASURED, partial-exit leg not charged: declared gaps)
analysis_declared: mean gross R, n, 95% CI (normal), win share over all approaches (primary)
split: approaches where entry bar == trigger bar (identical to Arm A) vs reclaim later (the only genuinely new trades)
Arm A on the same 'reclaim later' approaches and the paired per-approach difference B minus A
no other cut, no parameter variation, run ONCE
verdict_rule: POSITIVE_DIAGNOSTIC only if the lower 95% bound of mean GROSS R over all approaches > 0; NEGATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC if the upper bound < 0; otherwise NULL_INSUFFICIENT. A POSITIVE would still grant no authority (post hoc, same corpus, no holdout).
prediction: NULL_INSUFFICIENT. Expected |mean gross R| < 0.30 with a CI crossing zero (n<=36, per-trade sd ~1.2R). Only about 18 trades differ from Arm A so power to detect a real difference is near zero.
